task: Inkbox-G4-P1C-Luna-海陆连通性原型开发委托书-v1.0

prototype.connectivity: four-neighbor flood from all edge cells with height < SEA_LEVEL
prototype.cachePersistence: WeakMap runtime-only; rebuilt from height after restore
prototype.cacheInvalidation: explicit height mutation notification when strict sea-level passability changes; dimensions/height-layer replacement auto-detected

coverage: edge ocean and world without ocean
closed low basin, canal opening and dam closure
residual water, pump, injection and riverBase
erosion-created topology change and next-tick event ordering
map progress expansion without array resize

naturalMapComparison.interpretation: Existing generator supplies one-time water to all below-sea cells; disconnected cells then participate in finite flow/evaporation rather than receiving static sea refill.

performance.machine: Windows 10, Node v24.11.1, Intel Core i3-12100
performance.method: three seeds per size, five warmup ticks, eight single-tick samples, sixteen-tick sustained segment; Node CPU timing, no GPU claim
performance.memoryModel: nine bytes per cell: one-byte mask + four-byte queue + shared four-byte delta buffer; object and engine memory not measured
performance.performanceClaim: no consistent speedup claim; measured cost is near the existing V3 order of magnitude and topology reflood occurs only after explicit passability crossings

knownRisks: Initial generated disconnected lowlands retain the generator's one-time static-sea water as finite water.
Four-neighbor connectivity treats diagonal-only contact as closed; one cell below SEA_LEVEL is enough to connect a canal.
The prototype relies on event notifications for in-place terrain writes; missed product hooks would leave a stale cache.
P1C was not connected to the product Canvas/Three loop and did not receive real-browser acceptance in this task.
A small natural-map sample has very few enclosed subsea cells; gameplay value mainly appears after player terrain edits.
integrationTouchpoints: powers.js terrain brushes, History.undo, and UI tool dispatch
automatic water and thermal erosion threshold crossings
derived type/qi and dirty rendering updates
Canvas/Three browser and mortal/upper/nether isolation acceptance
nextMinimumAction: Create an isolated opt-in integration task for ocean-connected-v3; wire all height threshold events and restore rebuild; define initial generated inland-water semantics; run actual Canvas and Three save/undo/canal/dam/erosion scenarios before any default-rule decision.
